products.title: Get The F**k Off Me Back Escapes by Ethan Crelinsten
products.body:
B-Team Standout Ethan Crelinsten Uncovers His Complete Back Defense System Including Preventative Measures, Escapes, Reversals, Overtime Strategies, and MORE!

  • Ethan Crelinsten is a multiple time ADCC Vet, one of the top competitors in the sport, and has a proven back escape curriculum that ANYONE can learn!
  • Explore concepts that will help you understand essentials of back control, weight distribution, hand fighting, “strangle territory”, and more!
  • Develop early, mid, and late stage defensive strategies that Ethan has used throughout his accomplished career.
  • Learn to properly gauge danger when your back is exposed/taken and take proportionate measures to escape or reverse the position with precise tactics.
  • Build confidence in your defense with battle-tested escapes that will have you escaping some of the most dominant controls from the back.
  • Discover consistent methods of escaping DEEP back control including body triangles, double unders with both hooks, seatbelts with both hooks, cross body ride, and many other commonly used back control variations!
  • Demoralize opponents by escaping the most dominant position in Jiu-Jitsu with B-Team standout Ethan Crelinsten!

products.title: Finish on the Back by Ethan Crelinsten
products.body:
B-Team Jiu-jitsu co-founder Ethan Crelinsten is one of the most active competitors and innovators in the modern no gi jiu-jitsu scene, establishing himself as a household name with multiple high level wins over the course of his career  

  • Get a firsthand look at Crelinsten’s amazing systems for maintaining, attacking, and FINISHING from BJJ’s best position
  • Learn the most high percentage back escapes in the game so you can understand what it takes to retain the back position on a deeper level
  • Utilize multiple attacks that Crelisnten has used at the highest levels of no gi competition to control, domainte, and submit top tier opponents
  • Master an entire library of rear naked choke gold that will help you get the tap and become more well rounded and dangerous from the back


Attack the Back Like Never Before and Master The Art of The Finish with 2-Time ADCC Trials Champion and B-Team Jiu-Jitsu Co-Founder Ethan Crelinsten


 

Check out a free sample:

What Will You Learn?

Ethan Crelinsten accomplished some of the most daunting feats in grappling as a colored belt, winning the ADCC Trials twice under the tutelage of Firas Zahabi and John Danaher. The former DDS member has since gone on to co-found B-Team Jiu-Jitsu along with some of the sport's biggest names. Crelinsten continues to innovate, train, and compete from his new homebase in Austin Texas and with his very first instructional on the back position, you’re going to get a firsthand look at Crelinsten’s amazing strategies for maintaining and attacking, from what most consider to be the BEST position in all of BJJ!

 

Crelinsten will start with a deep dive into high percentage back escapes. This revolutionary instructional format will help you understand the intentions of your opponents on a deeper level before you get into the attacks. You’ll get Ethan’s best retention secrets to help you to help you maintain the position for longer and develop superior recognition skills so you can stop escapes before they start. Once you’ve mastered the art of back maintenance, he’ll guide you through a monster library of trustworthy attacks that will have you submitting your training partners and opponents with greater frequency and precision. From massive amounts of rear naked choke details, to back triangle and armabar secrets you'll only get with Crelinsten, you'll have enough here to keep you busy for months as you round out your skillset and become a more dangerous grappler! 

 

Crelinsten is on the forefront of the no gi scene and his instruction is top notch. If you’re looking for a modern guide that will give you a new and exciting approach to the back, look no further. Crelinsten has already put these strategies to the test with incredible results and now you can see what the B-Team star has been cooking up behind the scenes! Develop a more dominant game from the back and start enjoying more success from BJJ’s best position!

products.title: Leg Lock Counters by Ethan Crelinsten
products.body:
Check out some of the best techniques in the game to counter leg locks by taking the back, passing the guard, and entering into your own leg locks

  • Use positions like the outside De La Riva, inside De La Riva, lasso guard, spider guard, and more to your advantage with Felipe’s techniques for passing
  • Get to the back with ease from top or bottom 50/50 and utilize the most effective ashi counters
  • Focus intensely on standard, outside, and cross ashi and become so proficient from these positions that you are confident in knowing you can do whatever you want from here
  • Learn how to counter inversions before they become a threat and shut down your opponents attack with your own high level offense
  • Counter directly into backside 50/50, reverse figure four, and so many other high level positions where you can launch unstoppable attacks

Become A Leg Lock Countering Monster And Use These Counters To Launch Swift And Effective Attacks With Brazilian Jiu Jitsu Black Belt Ethan Crelinsten

Check out a free sample:

What Will You Learn?

World class competitor and Brazilian Jiu Jitsu Ethan Crelinsten dives into the dark side of leg locks to help you learn not only how to stay safe, but to use counters to take advantage of your opponents attempted attacks. This includes countless variations of back takes, guard passes, and countering leg locks with your own leg locks! Becoming proficient in leg locks is essential in modern day Jiu Jitsu, so be sure to take advantage of all this series has to offer.

Getting into all of the small yet important details from each position, Ethan leaves nothing out when it comes to giving you a full understanding of these positions. As an ADCC veteran who has competed at the highest levels in this sport, Ethan uses his real world experience to bring you some of the best techniques available on the market. You can be sure that you will learn the most important aspects of every technique covered in this series.

Counter inversions, back steps, and more to get to the back before your opponent even knows what hit them. Make your opponent think twice before entering into the legs when they see that you have a high level answer to each of their attacks. In compiling all of the knowledge and technique you will pick up in this instructional, you will surely notice the new confidence you have when stepping onto the mats.

Although leg locks are typically known to be more advanced techniques, the techniques in this series can be applied to all levels of the sport. Leg locks continue to be an ever growing part of Jiu Jitsu and you need to have the best techniques in the game to keep up with the evolution. With this series, you can rest assured that you will be competent with the legs and no opponent is going to attack you with something that you don’t have an answer for. Elevate your game to the next level and don’t skip out on your chance to retain everything in this series!
